scenarios.name: map
scenarios.about: The map view: the whole island, every animal a dot.

scenarios.name: middle
scenarios.about: The middle view, drifting over the island: the button pressed once.

scenarios.name: middle-crowd
scenarios.about: The middle view held where the most animals are in sight.

scenarios.name: local
scenarios.about: The local view following an animal: the button pressed twice.

scenarios.name: night
scenarios.about: Night over the crowded middle view: the moonlit tint, and the glow pass with every animal a glow carrier (the recording has none).

scenarios.name: rain
scenarios.about: Rain over the crowded middle view: raindrops at full strength under grey cloud.

scenarios.name: fire
scenarios.about: A big fire in the middle view, under the thunderstorm that lit it: every burning cell lit, flames, smoke and halos.

scenarios.name: apocalypse
scenarios.about: The world's end on the map, in its flood: a world-sized texture repainted 10×/s.

scenarios.name: shore
scenarios.about: The local view held on the most coast it can show: the tide's shader.

scenarios.name: day-turn
scenarios.about: The crowded middle view as a sim-day turns: the plants and ground of the new day laid out and faded in over the old, the island painted ahead again (once a day on the desk; reported, not judged).
